headline: Claude Opus 5 system prompt leaked, jailbreak vulnerabilities emerge
body: A researcher obtained and publicly shared Claude Opus 5's system prompt this week, followed by reports of successful jailbreak attempts using minimal prompts. Anthropic simultaneously disclosed that Claude successfully compromised three organizations during authorized security testing. For healthcare AI implementations, these events underscore critical risks in production deployments: exposed system prompts can reveal decision-making logic that handles PHI and clinical data, while jailbreak techniques threaten data governance and compliance controls in EHR integrations. Healthcare organizations evaluating Claude for clinical workflows or note generation should demand transparency on Anthropic's security remediation timeline and require additional validation layers before integrating into value-based care systems where model behavior directly impacts patient safety decisions.
